issues.failure_explanation: The Beta-type integral \int_h^t s^{-\gamma/\alpha}(t-s)^{-1/\alpha}ds equals a constant times t^{1-(\gamma+1)/\alpha}=t^{-\beta/\alpha}, which is not bounded uniformly in t (and h). The displayed estimate |\Delta_2|\lesssim \bar p_\alpha(t,y-x)h^{\gamma/\alpha} with a constant independent of t is therefore not justified as written; the correct bound carries the extra singular factor t^{-\beta/\alpha}.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the right-hand side of the \Delta_2 bound by \bar p_\alpha(t,y-x)h^{\gamma/\alpha}t^{-\beta/\alpha}\lesssim (1+t^{-\beta/\alpha})\bar p_\alpha(t,y-x)h^{\gamma/\alpha}, which is absorbed in the gathered estimate.
issues.overall_effect: Only the intermediate estimate for \Delta_2 is misstated; the final statement of Theorem thm-main already contains the factor (1+t^{-\beta/\alpha}), so the theorem's conclusion is unaffected once the factor is carried through the Gronwall step (where the same singular inhomogeneity is already handled).
issues.title: Time integral in the bound for Delta_2 is not uniformly bounded; a factor t^{-beta/alpha} is dropped
issues.why_classification: A local one-line correction of an integral evaluation; the conclusion, rate and scope of the theorem are preserved without new arguments.

The scheme part of \Delta_6 is E[b(U,X^h_{	au_s^h})\cdot
abla p_\alpha(t-s,y-X^h_s)], where X^h_s=X^h_{	au_s^h}+b(U,X^h_{	au_s^h})(s-	au_s^h)+Z_s-Z_{	au_s^h}
eq X^h_{	au_s^h}. Conditioning on (X^h_{	au_s^h},U) and using harmonicity gives the integrand \Gamma^h(0,x,	au_s^h,z)b(r,z)\cdot
abla p_\alpha(t-	au_s^h,y-z-b(r,z)(s-	au_s^h)), not \Gamma^h(0,x,	au_s^h,z)b(r,z)\cdot

The written identity silently drops the z-dependent drift shift b(r,z)(s-	au_s^h), which is exactly what required the pivot/Taylor treatment (\Delta_{431},\Delta_{432}) elsewhere; the cancellation argument invoked via \eqref{USEFUL_FOR_DELTA_6} cannot be applied directly to the true term.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Rewrite \Delta_{62} with the correct integrand and treat it as \Delta_{43}: pivot the drift shift to b(r,y); bound the difference term via \eqref{drift-smoothing-iso-noise-diag} by (s-\tau_s^h)(t-\tau_s^h)^{(\beta-2)/\alpha}\bar p_\alpha, whose integral over [\tau_t^h-h,t] is \lesssim h^{2-(2-\beta)/\alpha}\le h^{\gamma/\alpha}; and apply the cancellation bound \eqref{USEFUL_FOR_DELTA_6} (keeping the h^{\beta/\alpha} term) at the shifted point \mathfrak y=y-b(r,y)(s-\tau_s^h) with kernel time t-\tau_s^h\ge t-s, recovering \eqref{maj-D6-mainthm}.
issues.overall_effect: The derivation of \eqref{maj-D6-mainthm} for the scheme contribution on the last time steps is unsupported as written; the final bound for \Delta_6 and hence the gathered estimate feeding the Gronwall step depends on it.
